notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
First QoL patch is now live:

[list]
[*] Deal with the Devil triggering a card behind fixed (I think - haven't been able to reproduce after patch)
[*] Flippy Asset - Death Floor/Ceiling are now working properly
[*] Games published count now accurately only counts games
[*] Mini resource icon indicators now reset properly after swiping
[*] Minor card value tuning pass
[*] Grammar and spelling fixes
[/list]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33185989/e7aa801e4aee1745fe369841f393d6bee25cbbb3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33185989/99450368f34a3abf74e697d028af297de9cb19b0.png[/img][/url]

As always, thanks for playing!

Jeff and the MES Team

notes.title: 0.1.5 Patch
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33185989/933090ef431c2f0766296cbc2faf52e0271ad219.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33185989/8318497e4ded1967b8d589c33d862ce4b24defab.png[/img][/url]-

- Added a Save/Load system
- Added arrow & Numpad support for Hack minigame
- Added an expanded tutorial 2.0
- Nerfed Flippy minigame (size of collider)
- Added High Score Hack minigame
- Added High Score Whack minigame
- Added High Score Flip minimgame
- Added High Score Months survived
- Added High Score Games released
- Added approx 100 more cards
- Fixed load screen error
- Fixed Deal with the Devil sprite error
- Changed install path to correct name
- Assorted minor bug fixes
- Assorted grammar fixes

In progress:
- Achieves are temporarily broken
- Some Card resource values are way off
- Resolution Full Screen selection
- Resolution default selection broken
- Minigame "juice" - (this means gameplay look/feel stuff)
- Death Floor/Ceiling for Flippy minigame

Post Launch features: (in development, but won't be done before launch)
- Greenlight Man
- Direct Bot
- Invaders Minigame

Beta Testers, you may need to uninstall and reinstall due to the correction of folder naming/executable. And if you have any feedback for us (tonight) you can use the in game feedback form, or just DM us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/MutantStudios]@MutantStudios[/url]
